claim_boundary: fixed-weight descriptive screen; no causal channel, routing, adaptation, or learning claim
correction: v1 is retained as a partial descriptive run. The unimplemented gate-modulation coefficient is excluded before v2 collection because it lacked an arm-comparable operational definition. The Jacobian atlas remains baseline-only and is explicitly absent from this package.
final_slot_match: both primary arms end with base cue-pair4 at reliability .5
fitting_boundary: Fit decoder, projections, normalization, trackers and lag models only on base-order train32. Apply frozen objects to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
outcome: per-seed median across projections of delay8 base-minus-upstream true R2; latest/shuffle are verification controls only
selection_gate: For candidate m and seed s let c[m,s]=m_base,s-m_upstream,s and o[s]=outcome. A direction d in {-1,+1} is eligible only if at least 5/6 finite nonzero c[m,s] have sign d and leave-one-seed-out Spearman(c[m,-s],o[-s]) has sign d for at least 5/6 omissions. Resolve eligible ties by median(c[m,s]/SD_train_base[m,s]); zero SD excludes that seed. Full-six Spearman is descriptive only. Nominate at most one metric; no eligible metric means stop.
integrity: single-episode initial state is repeated across batched histories
save states route tensors fits predictions hashes
